info.title: Pawday service trade design — NOT IMPLEMENTED
info.description: V3.1.3-A design artifact. Synthetic schema examples are not HTTP responses. Active client contract remains pawday-v3.1.2.yaml. Real merchant policies remain PENDING.

servers.description: Reserved invalid domain. No deployed service.

get.description: Proposal only. Default-off non-production simulation with explicit TEST_SCENARIO terms; no actual money movement or accepted real merchant rules. Ownership and current store scope must be checked before idempotency replay. Assessment/preview snapshots create no financial intent. Missing terms fail closed. Refund and settlement decisions consume immutable server assessments with scope, version and expiry checks. Rejected refund decisions create no refund. Fulfillment requires confirmed collection; raw receipts are server-originated.
